Giving every child the chance to play tennis.

Aces for Access removes the cost barrier to tennis. We provide free rackets, free coaching, and free court time, led by a team that loves the sport and wants to help young people grow stronger through it.

Get in Touch See Our Programs
Free tennis for youth in Columbus, Ohio
Who we are

From one student's idea to a team.

Aces for Access was founded by Prathiksai Amathi, a varsity tennis player at Olentangy High School who wanted every child in Columbus to have the chance to play the sport he loves. It began as one student's idea. As it grew, other coaches, players, and volunteers joined and made the mission their own.

"A child with a racket and a good coach has a place to build strength and confidence, in tennis and beyond."

Tennis taught Prathik discipline, patience, and confidence. He wants every young athlete to have the same opportunity, regardless of what their family can afford. Joining him on our founding team are Aditya Balaji, Jashwin Pisini, Pariksith Pothamsetty, Harsha Ganduri, Vihaan Singharia, Gautham Bukkasamudram, and Karthi Yadlapalli. We all share the same goal. We love the sport, and we want to help children build physical and mental strength while giving back to the community that shaped us.

Aces for Access is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that provides free tennis equipment, court access, and coaching to underserved youth in Columbus. We are just getting started, and our first clinics are still ahead of us.

Our programs

Three ways we help kids play tennis.

01 / 03
Clinics

Free Group Clinics

Open sessions for ages 10 to 18 that combine fitness, fun, and stress relief through tennis.

02 / 03
Coaching

Coaching & Mentorship

Seven experienced volunteer coaches provide instruction and encouragement to help young players improve their game and build confidence.

03 / 03
Equipment

Equipment Donations

Free tennis rackets and gear, so that cost does not keep any child from playing. Participants keep their equipment after the clinic ends.

Our commitments

Four commitments at every clinic.

Every session we run is based on the same four commitments to the families we serve.

A

Provide evidence-based stress relief through physical activity and coaching.

B

Provide accessible equipment and court time at no cost.

C

Work with dedicated, background-checked volunteer coaches.

D

Offer group clinics and one-on-one lessons tailored to each player.
